papers.title: Optimizing YOLO27, YOLO26, YOLO11, and YOLOv8 for Fine-Grained Small-Object Detection and Segmentation in Complex Orchard Environments
papers.title_zh: YOLOv26、YOLOv11和YOLOv8跨代优化用于复杂果园细粒度小目标检测与实例分割
papers.reason: 该研究系统对比了YOLOv8/11/26在复杂果园环境中的小目标检测与分割性能，其方法（多尺度训练、模型规模对比）和结论（紧凑模型更优）对您在多源数据融合和遥感变化检测中的目标识别任务具有直接参考价值。
papers.summary_zh: 研究在苹果幼果、花萼和果梗的检测与分割任务上，对YOLOv8、YOLOv11和YOLOv26的五个模型规模进行了基准测试。结果显示，YOLOv11s-960在mask mAP@50:95上达到最高（0.402），而YOLOv26s-960以更少的参数（10.37M）取得了相当的性能（0.397），表明紧凑模型在小目标聚焦训练下更具效率优势。
papers.insight_zh: 在精细农业或遥感小目标检测中，增加模型容量并非总是提升精度，针对小目标的输入分辨率和模型规模选择可能比单纯追求大模型更关键，这为资源受限的边缘计算场景提供了模型选型依据。

papers.title: Chronosphere: Space-Time Tessellation of Local Climate Experts
papers.title_zh: Chronosphere：局部气候专家的时空细分
papers.reason: 该文提出Chronosphere时空神经场，用于学习气候表示，核心是地理表示学习中的自适应时空细分与局部基函数，与时空数据挖掘、地理空间智能及多源数据融合方向高度相关。
papers.abstract: We introduce Chronosphere, a spatio-temporal neural field that learns representations of climate. A central challenge in geographic representation learning is modeling environmental processes whose spatial and temporal complexity varies widely. Yet existing location encoders typically fix a single level of detail everywhere. Global bases such as spherical harmonics spread capacity uniformly across space and time. Localized bases resolve only predefined regions. Learned tessellations adapt, but are inefficient at representing higher frequencies. Chronosphere unifies these approaches, pairing an adaptive tessellation of learnable sites on the spacetime torus $S^2\times S^1$ with a shared bank of local basis functions. Both where capacity is placed and how much detail each region carries adapt to the data, across space and time. Trained to reconstruct climatology, Chronosphere matches or leads state-of-the-art location encoders across spatial and temporal tasks, with the largest gains under spatial and temporal transfer.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出Chronosphere，一种学习气候表示的时空神经场。地理表示学习的核心挑战在于建模时空复杂度差异很大的环境过程，而现有位置编码器通常在所有位置固定单一细节层级：球谐等全局基在时空上均匀分配容量，局部基只能解析预定义区域，学习式细分虽能自适应但表示高频效率不高。Chronosphere统一了这些方法，在时空环面S²×S¹上配对可学习站点的自适应细分与共享局部基函数库，使容量放置位置和每个区域的细节程度都能随数据在时空上自适应。以重建气候态为训练目标，Chronosphere在空间和时间任务上匹配或领先最先进的位置编码器，在空间和时间迁移下增益最大。
papers.insight_zh: 该文提示，将自适应细分与共享局部基结合，可让地理表示在时空上按数据复杂度分配容量，从而在迁移场景中取得更大优势，为气候等环境过程的表示学习提供了新路径。

papers.title: PerSeM: Persistent Semantic Memory for Long-Horizon Open-Vocabulary UAV Mapping
papers.title_zh: PerSeM：面向长时程开放词汇无人机建图的持久语义记忆
papers.reason: 该文提出面向长时程开放词汇无人机建图的持久语义记忆框架，涉及三维体素聚合与语义一致性，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合方向高度相关。
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary segmentation enables rich semantic perception for UAVs, but frame-wise predictions can remain temporally inconsistent across repeated observations and changing viewpoints. We present PerSeM, a training-free persistent semantic memory framework for long-horizon open-vocabulary UAV mapping. PerSeM associates frame-wise semantic observations with persistent world-space voxels and constructs a majority-based semantic memory, which is conservatively refined through history-preserving spatial refinement, trust-aware replay, and context-guided verification. Experiments on the Forest and UAVScenes benchmarks show that persistent 3D memory provides substantial gains in semantic correctness and temporal stability over frame-wise predictions. Beyond this strong persistent-memory baseline, PerSeM provides consistent additional improvements, improving both semantic accuracy and temporal stability across all five evaluated UAVScenes sequences. Analysis using regions identified independently of the final PerSeM predictions further shows that these gains are concentrated in semantically difficult and temporally unstable regions, where majority-based memory is most likely to remain uncertain. These results demonstrate that persistent 3D aggregation provides a strong foundation for long-horizon semantic mapping, while conservative refinement of uncertain memory states can provide additional improvements without retraining or additional neural-network inference.
papers.summary_zh: 开放词汇分割为无人机提供了丰富的语义感知能力，但逐帧预测在重复观测和视角变化下可能保持时间上不一致。作者提出PerSeM，一种无需训练的持久语义记忆框架，用于长时程开放词汇无人机建图。PerSeM将逐帧语义观测关联到持久的世界空间体素，构建基于多数投票的语义记忆，并通过保留历史的空间精化、信任感知重放和上下文引导验证进行保守细化。在Forest和UAVScenes基准上的实验表明，持久三维记忆在语义正确性和时间稳定性上相较逐帧预测有显著提升。除这一强持久记忆基线外，PerSeM还提供一致的额外改进，在全部五个评估的UAVScenes序列上同时提升语义精度和时间稳定性。使用独立于最终PerSeM预测识别的区域进行分析进一步表明，这些增益集中在语义困难和时间不稳定的区域，即基于多数投票的记忆最可能保持不确定的地方。这些结果表明，持久三维聚合为长时程语义建图提供了坚实基础，而对不确定记忆状态的保守细化可在无需重新训练或额外神经网络推理的情况下带来额外改进。
papers.insight_zh: 该框架的持久三维语义记忆与保守细化策略，可为遥感变化检测中的时序一致性问题和多源数据融合中的不确定性处理提供方法借鉴，尤其适用于观测视角多变、语义模糊的城市遥感场景。

papers.title_zh: GeoSelect：面向免训练指代遥感图像分割的空间程序执行

papers.title: Attributing Cohen's d: Training Data Attribution for Disease-Related Effects in Normative Age Biomarkers
papers.title_zh: 归因Cohen's d：规范年龄生物标志物中疾病相关效应的训练数据归因
papers.reason: 论文提出将疾病相关效应归因于训练样本的方法，应用于UK Biobank的脑部MRI和代谢组学数据，与医学影像分析和数据挖掘方法相关，对多源数据融合有参考价值。
papers.abstract: Normative age models are trained to predict chronological age in a nominally healthy cohort. Applied to patients, they deviate, and the gap between predicted and chronological age is read as disease risk. Here, we attribute the disease-related effect size of the age gap directly to individual training samples, rather than using a prediction-level loss as the attribution target. For Cohen's $d$, the resulting closed-form influence functional, validated against leave-one-out retraining, ranks training samples by their effect on held-out case-control separation. Across four diseases and two biomarker modalities in UK Biobank, removing the 10% most influential training samples raises held-out disease-related effect size in every seed. It more than doubles the metabolomic-age effect for type-2 diabetes and raises the brain-age effect for multiple sclerosis by roughly a third. Random removal leaves effect size flat even at 50% removal, confirming the gain comes from which samples are removed, not how many. Flagged subjects carry subclinical cardiometabolic burden that diagnosis-based exclusion misses, on markers the model never sees. For type-2 diabetes, where the method gains most, the marker recovered is HbA1c, the standard measure of blood sugar control. We release pyinfluence, our influence-function package, for reproducibility and reuse.
papers.summary_zh: 论文提出一种新的影响函数，将年龄差距的疾病相关效应大小（Cohen's d）直接归因于单个训练样本。在UK Biobank的四种疾病和两种生物标志物模态上，移除最具影响力的10%训练样本可提高所有种子下的留出疾病相关效应。对于2型糖尿病，代谢组学年龄效应提升超过一倍；对于多发性硬化症，脑龄效应提升约三分之一。被标记的受试者携带模型未见过的亚临床心血管代谢负担。
papers.insight_zh: 该方法通过识别并移除对病例-对照分离有负面影响的训练样本，能有效提升规范年龄模型的疾病风险预测能力，并可能发现基于诊断排除所遗漏的亚临床疾病标志物。

papers.title: What Remains Normal? Clean Images Miss Useful Near-Defect Normal Patches for Anomaly Detection
papers.title_zh: 什么仍然正常？干净图像遗漏了用于异常检测的有用近缺陷正常补丁
papers.reason: 研究记忆库异常检测中训练污染对记忆组成的影响，提出清理方法，与遥感变化检测中的异常识别和样本质量控制高度相关。
papers.abstract: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP.Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jw-chae/cleancon.
papers.summary_zh: 本文探讨记忆库异常检测中稀疏训练污染的影响，发现全局覆盖选择会过度代表污染，并提出CLEANCON门控方法减少污染，但最低污染记忆并非性能最优。
papers.insight_zh: 记忆库的污染程度与检测性能并非单调相关，过度清理可能损失有用信息，这提示在遥感变化检测中需平衡样本纯净度与信息完整性。

papers.title: Measuring Digital Labour Market Transitions with a Digital Semantic Score: An AI-Based Methodology Applied to the Dutch Labour Market
papers.title_zh: 利用数字语义评分衡量数字劳动力市场转型：一种基于AI的方法应用于荷兰劳动力市场
papers.reason: 该研究利用AI方法（嵌入与大语言模型）分析劳动力市场的数字化转型，与GIS博士研究中关于时空数据挖掘和LLM应用的主题高度相关，为城市更新中的人力资本动态提供了方法论参考。
papers.summary_zh: 本研究提出一种基于AI的方法，利用嵌入相似性搜索和LLM分类，将数百万荷兰职位档案的非结构化信息映射到统一的ESCO职业分类，并引入数字语义评分来衡量职位名称和技能与数字概念的关联强度。该方法超越了基于关键词的方法，能够分析职业、职业转换、新兴职位词汇和技能数字化程度。研究发现数字化在劳动力市场中分布不均，数字职位语言在管理、专业和ICT职业中最为突出，但在混合业务、营销和自动化相关角色中日益可见。职业转换分析表明向数字工作的流动依赖于路径，技能分析则凸显了数字能力的多维性。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究展示了如何将LLM和嵌入技术应用于大规模社会经济数据，以揭示数字转型的结构性特征，其方法论可迁移至其他领域的地理空间文本分析。

papers.title: Learning to Move Cities: Deep Meta-Models and Reinforcement Policies for Calibration and Control in Urban Networks
papers.title_zh: 学习移动城市：城市网络校准与控制的深度元模型与强化学习策略
papers.reason: 该文面向城市交通网络的仿真校准与实时控制，提出连接校准与强化学习控制的共享潜空间框架，直接涉及城市网络、交通动态与深度学习方法，与城市更新和时空数据挖掘方向较为相关。
papers.abstract: Urban transportation networks present complex optimization challenges spanning calibration of high-fidelity simulators and real-time operational control. This paper presents a shared latent-space framework that connects simulator calibration and reinforcement learning control through a common learned representation of urban traffic dynamics. First, we develop a combinatorial MLP-autoencoder architecture that learns low-dimensional manifolds linking simulator inputs (origin-destination demand, network parameters) to outputs (travel times, congestion patterns), enabling efficient Bayesian optimization for calibration. This approach demonstrates superior sample efficiency compared to traditional dimension reduction methods, achieving better fit to observational data within fixed computational budgets. Second, we implement a deep Q-learning agent with experience replay and target networks to optimize dynamic traffic assignment through scheduling and routing adjustments. In empirical evaluations on benchmark networks, our approach reduces system-wide travel times by up to 51% compared to baseline operations. The learned latent representation is not only used to reduce the dimensionality of Bayesian calibration, but is also incorporated into the reinforcement learning state representation, allowing the control policy to operate on compressed and calibrated traffic dynamics. This shared latent-space formulation provides a unified pathway from simulator calibration to adaptive operational control within intelligent transportation systems. Our results highlight the transformative potential of deep learning methods in urban mobility planning and management, particularly for large-scale networks where traditional optimization approaches face computational bottlenecks.
papers.summary_zh: 城市交通网络优化面临高保真仿真器校准与实时运行控制等复杂挑战。该文提出共享潜空间框架，通过城市交通动态的共同学习表示连接仿真器校准与强化学习控制。首先，作者开发组合式MLP自编码器架构，学习连接仿真器输入（起讫需求、网络参数）与输出（行程时间、拥堵模式）的低维流形，从而支持高效的贝叶斯优化校准；相比传统降维方法，该方法在固定计算预算下样本效率更高，对观测数据拟合更好。其次，作者实现带经验回放和目标网络的深度Q学习智能体，通过调度和路径调整优化动态交通分配。在基准网络上的实证评估中，该方法相较基线运营将系统总行程时间最多降低51%。学习到的潜表示不仅用于降低贝叶斯校准的维度，也被纳入强化学习状态表示，使控制策略能够在压缩且校准后的交通动态上运行。
papers.insight_zh: 该文表明，共享潜空间公式可为从仿真器校准到自适应运行控制提供统一路径，深度学习方法在城市出行规划与管理中具有潜力，尤其适用于传统优化方法面临计算瓶颈的大规模网络。

papers.title: The Role of Radiometric Features in Cross-Site Leaf-Wood Segmentation of LiDAR Point Clouds
papers.title_zh: 辐射特征在LiDAR点云跨站点叶木分割中的作用
papers.reason: 该论文研究LiDAR点云的叶木分割，强调辐射特征在跨站点、跨平台泛化中的作用，与多源数据融合和遥感变化检测中的特征工程相关。
papers.abstract: Leaf-wood segmentation of individual trees from LiDAR point clouds is essential for quantitative structure models (QSMs) used in non-destructive biomass estimation. Existing segmentation methods typically exclude radiometric features (e.g., intensity, return number) to maximize cross-sensor compatibility. We challenge this design choice by evaluating cross-site and cross-platform generalization: training on the public Heidelberg dataset (terrestrial TLS, 1550nm) and testing on a novel dataset from Ontario, Canada (RPA-LS, 905nm). Results show that geometry-only methods - including state-of-the-art deep learning models trained on high-density LiDAR datasets - fail to generalize to the sparse, top-down geometry of aerial scans, achieving F1 scores <= 0.56. Incorporating radiometric features (intensity, return number, number of returns) improves F1 to 0.61, but more critically, increases wood recall by 119% from 0.16 to 0.35. Furthermore, geometry-only approaches often result in fragmented stem and branch components. We find that leveraging radiometric features preserves greater structural connectivity, resulting in more coherent architectures that are better suited for QSM reconstruction. We demonstrate that while geometric patterns are view-dependent and prone to overfitting scan patterns, radiometric features encode physical material properties that generalize across disparate sensors and environments.
papers.summary_zh: 从LiDAR点云中分割单棵树的叶与木质部分对于定量结构模型（QSM）和非破坏性生物量估计至关重要。现有分割方法通常排除辐射特征（如强度、回波次数）以最大化跨传感器兼容性。本文挑战这一设计选择，评估跨站点和跨平台泛化能力：在公开的Heidelberg数据集（地面TLS，1550nm）上训练，在加拿大安大略省的新数据集（RPA-LS，905nm）上测试。结果表明，仅使用几何特征的方法——包括在高密度LiDAR数据集上训练的最先进深度学习模型——无法泛化到稀疏、俯视的航空扫描几何，F1分数不超过0.56。引入辐射特征（强度、回波次数、回波数量）将F1提升至0.61，更重要的是将木质召回率从0.16提升119%至0.35。此外，仅几何方法常导致树干和树枝组件碎片化。研究发现利用辐射特征可保持更好的结构连通性，产生更适合QSM重建的连贯架构。研究证明，几何模式具有视角依赖性且容易过拟合扫描模式，而辐射特征编码了可跨不同传感器和环境泛化的物理材料属性。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提示在多源LiDAR数据融合中，辐射特征可能比纯几何特征具有更强的跨域泛化能力，这对城市三维重建和遥感变化检测中的特征选择具有启发意义。

papers.title: Adaptive World Memory 3D Foundation Model for Scalable 3D Mapping, Localization, and Rendering
papers.title_zh: 面向可扩展3D建图、定位与渲染的自适应世界记忆3D基础模型
papers.reason: 该论文研究3D基础模型用于可扩展的3D建图、定位和渲染，涉及SLAM、高斯渲染和三维重建，与地理空间智能和城市三维建模有较强关联。
papers.abstract: Recent 3D foundation models enable generalizable geometric reasoning from RGB images but remain limited in persistent memory, scalability, and renderable scene modeling. We present a memory-centric 3D foundation model for scalable robotic localization, reconstruction, and Gaussian rendering. Its core is an adaptive world memory mechanism that combines transformer-based gated updates with test-time temporal-spatial regulation. Learned gates control recurrent memory propagation, while temporal state evolution and spatial observation-state consistency regulate token-wise updates and forgetting over long image sequences. To support large-scale mapping, we organize memory into local submaps and integrate progressive mapping and tracking, loop closure, and SL(4)-based global refinement to maintain local accuracy and global consistency. A Gaussian reconstruction head decodes memory-enhanced features into renderable primitives, unifying camera pose estimation, dense point-cloud reconstruction, and photorealistic rendering within a single model. Experiments on public benchmarks and self-collected datasets from diverse robotic platforms demonstrate improved trajectory accuracy, reconstruction completeness, and rendering quality over existing 3D foundation reconstruction and SLAM baselines. These results support adaptive memory as a foundation for persistent robotic world modeling. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
papers.summary_zh: 近期3D基础模型能够从RGB图像进行可泛化的几何推理，但在持久记忆、可扩展性和可渲染场景建模方面仍受限。本文提出一个以记忆为中心的3D基础模型，用于可扩展的机器人定位、重建和高斯渲染。其核心是自适应世界记忆机制，结合基于Transformer的门控更新与测试时时空调节。学习到的门控控制循环记忆传播，而时间状态演化和空间观测-状态一致性调节长图像序列中的逐token更新和遗忘。为支持大规模建图，将记忆组织为局部子图，并集成渐进建图与跟踪、回环检测和基于SL(4)的全局优化，以保持局部精度和全局一致性。高斯重建头将记忆增强特征解码为可渲染基元，在单一模型中统一相机位姿估计、稠密点云重建和逼真渲染。在公开基准和来自多样机器人平台的自采数据集上的实验表明，相比现有3D基础重建和SLAM基线，轨迹精度、重建完整性和渲染质量均有提升。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作的自适应世界记忆机制和SL(4)全局优化策略，或对城市级三维重建和时空数据挖掘中的长期记忆建模具有方法学借鉴意义。

papers.title: RAVE: Re-Allocating Visual Attention in Large Multimodal Models
papers.title_zh: RAVE：大型多模态模型中的视觉注意力重分配
papers.reason: 该研究关注多模态大模型中的视觉注意力重分配，与GIS中利用大模型进行遥感影像或城市图像理解密切相关，可提升对关键空间要素的聚焦能力。
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出RAVE方法，通过重新分配大型多模态模型中的视觉注意力，以改善模型对图像关键区域的关注，从而提升视觉理解任务的性能。

papers.title: AutoViewMem: Self-Configuring Orthogonal Views for Conversational Long-Term Memory
papers.title_zh: AutoViewMem：面向对话式长期记忆的自配置正交视图
papers.reason: 该论文研究LLM智能体的长期对话记忆组织与检索，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间数据或城市更新场景。
papers.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for large language model (LLM) agents to maintain consistency and personalization over extended interactions. Existing memory systems typically rely on fixed granularities or static schemas, but these designs struggle when heterogeneous information, such as preferences, events, constraints, and temporal updates, is embedded in a single mixed representation. The resulting semantic interference makes top-K retrieval sensitive to noise and often leaves relevant evidence poorly ranked. We present AutoViewMem, a data-driven framework that organizes long-term conversational memory into self-configuring, low-overlap semantic views before indexing. AutoViewMem discovers candidate views from interaction traces, selects a compact complementary view set, and uses these views to guide write-time structured extraction of provenance-grounded memories. This representation-first design moves semantic disentanglement from retrieval time to write time, allowing standard top-K similarity search to retrieve focused evidence without explicit routing or iterative retrieval. We further apply offline consolidation to improve memory compactness and consistency. Experiments on the LoCoMo and PersonaMem benchmarks, under both Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B backbones, show that AutoViewMem improves long-horizon question answering and personalization over strong memory baselines while preserving a simple inference pipeline.
papers.summary_zh: 长期记忆对大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在长程交互中保持一致性与个性化至关重要。现有记忆系统通常依赖固定粒度或静态模式，但当偏好、事件、约束和时间更新等异构信息嵌入单一混合表示时，这些设计难以应对，由此产生的语义干扰使top-K检索对噪声敏感，相关证据排序不佳。本文提出AutoViewMem，一个数据驱动框架，在索引前将长期对话记忆组织为自配置、低重叠的语义视图。AutoViewMem从交互轨迹中发现候选视图，选择紧凑的互补视图集，并利用这些视图指导写入时的结构化提取，生成有来源依据的记忆。这种表示优先的设计将语义解耦从检索时移至写入时，使标准top-K相似度搜索无需显式路由或迭代检索即可获取聚焦证据。作者进一步应用离线整合以提升记忆的紧凑性与一致性。在LoCoMo和PersonaMem基准上，基于Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B骨干的实验表明，AutoViewMem在保持简单推理流程的同时，在长程问答和个性化方面优于强记忆基线。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示，将语义解耦前移到写入阶段可降低检索噪声，这一思路或可迁移至多源地理时空数据的组织与索引，但论文本身未涉及地理空间应用。

papers.title: MIRAGE: Multi-Perspective Creative Language Model Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning Guidance
papers.title_zh: MIRAGE：基于强化学习引导的多视角创造性语言模型推理
papers.reason: 该论文提出多视角推理时框架MIRAGE，包含选择器与推理器两个智能体式组件，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向直接相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized artificial intelligence and how human interact with AIs. Despite impressive advancements, LLMs struggle with complex mathematical, scientific, and logical tasks. Inspired by human cognitive flexibility - our ability to dynamically switch mental perspectives - we propose MIRAGE (Multi-perspective Inference-time Reasoning via Agent-Guided Exploration), a novel inference-time creative thinking framework. MIRAGE includes a Selector that prioritizes effective conceptual perspectives (e.g., algebraic, probabilistic) and a Reasoner that sequentially solves tasks until a confident solution emerges, otherwise aggregating multiple perspectives. Tested on GSM8K, MATH500, MMLU-Pro, and Game-of-24 benchmarks, MIRAGE consistently outperforms methods like Chain-of-Thought and diverse prompting ensembles, significantly boosting accuracy with minimal inference overhead, providing a scalable solution for practical applications.
papers.summary_zh: 受人类认知灵活性（动态切换思维视角的能力）启发，作者提出MIRAGE（多视角推理时推理，经由智能体引导探索），一种新颖的推理时创造性思维框架。MIRAGE包含一个选择器，用于优先选取有效的概念视角（如代数、概率视角），以及一个推理器，顺序求解任务直至出现置信解，否则聚合多个视角。在GSM8K、MATH500、MMLU-Pro和Game-of-24基准上，MIRAGE持续优于思维链和多样化提示集成等方法，在极小的推理开销下显著提升准确率，为实际应用提供了可扩展方案。
papers.insight_zh: 该框架的智能体引导多视角探索机制可迁移至地理空间智能中的复杂推理任务（如多源数据融合决策），但其验证仅限于数学与逻辑基准，尚需在地理空间场景中检验。

papers.title: AI-GRACE: A Use-Case Operationalization Framework for Agentic AI: From Organizational Objectives and Obligations to Deployment Capabilities and Architecture
papers.title_zh: AI-GRACE：面向智能体AI的用例操作化框架——从组织目标与义务到部署能力与架构
papers.reason: 该文提出智能体AI用例操作化框架，涉及治理、风险、保障与控制，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: Organizations deploying agentic artificial intelligence must determine more than whether a model is trustworthy; they must establish what to validate, control, and observe for a use case to deliver its intended outcome while meeting applicable obligations. This paper proposes AI-GRACE (Agentic Intelligence-Governance, Risk, Assurance, Controls, and Evidence) as a use-case operationalization framework connecting organizational governance with technical implementation. The proposal draws on professional observations and a purposive synthesis of standards and literature, using design science to frame the method contribution and situational method engineering to guide contextual tailoring and reuse. The framework establishes objectives and obligations and then assesses risks in seven proposed domains, including mission and value realization. It derives requirements for assurance before deployment, runtime controls, and evidence, which guide capability qualification, gap assessment, and a logical architecture. An Agent Operating Envelope specifies permitted actions and escalation conditions, while Risk-Aligned Independence Levels (RAIL) summarize the authorized independence. A fictional retail banking application illustrates the method. The contribution is a traceable basis for deciding what an organization must implement, what it already supports, and what remains unresolved. Empirical evaluation must establish whether it improves deployment decisions, efficiency, and reuse.
papers.summary_zh: 组织在部署智能体人工智能时，不仅需要判断模型是否可信，还必须确定在特定用例中需要验证、控制和观测哪些内容，以在满足适用义务的同时实现预期结果。本文提出AI-GRACE（智能体智能—治理、风险、保障、控制与证据），作为一个连接组织治理与技术实现的用例操作化框架。该提案基于专业观察以及对标准和文献的目的性综合，采用设计科学来构建方法贡献，并运用情境方法工程来指导情境化裁剪与复用。框架先确立目标与义务，然后在七个拟议领域（包括使命与价值实现）中评估风险。它推导出部署前保障、运行时控制和证据的要求，用以指导能力资格认定、差距评估和逻辑架构。智能体操作包络规定了允许的操作和升级条件，而风险对齐独立性等级（RAIL）则概括了授权的独立性。一个虚构的零售银行应用示例说明了该方法。其贡献在于为组织决定必须实施什么、已支持什么以及仍有哪些未解决问题提供了可追溯的依据。实证评估仍需确定它是否能改善部署决策、效率和复用。
papers.insight_zh: 该框架可为多智能体系统在复杂组织环境中的部署提供治理与风险控制思路，但其在GIS或城市更新场景中的适用性尚未验证。

papers.title: Rethinking Multi-Agent Collaboration: When More Is Less
papers.title_zh: 重新思考多智能体协作：更多未必更好
papers.reason: 该文系统分析多智能体协作的能力边界，并提出基于语义感知增量图演化的协作机制，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向直接相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models and single-agent harnesses has reshaped the landscape of autonomous systems, raising a critical question of when multi-agent collaboration offers genuine value. As individual agent capabilities continue to scale, multi-agent collaboration faces diminishing returns while incurring growing context overhead. Through systematic analysis, we delineate the capability boundaries of multi-agent collaboration relative to single-agent alternatives, showing that it confers systematic benefits specifically in long-horizon tasks with sparse dependencies, while single-agent harnesses remain superior in tightly coupled, sequential workflows. Building on these insights, we propose SAIGE, a lightweight multi-agent collaboration mechanism based on Semantic-Aware Incremental Graph Evolution. SAIGE models collaboration as a dynamically evolving graph, where nodes are agent instances spawned on demand and edges encode semantic dependencies established through content-based information retrieval. Experiments on long-horizon, complex task benchmarks show that SAIGE achieves a favorable trade-off between context efficiency and task performance, and that scaling the agent pool or deepening the recursion level does not consistently improve outcomes. Our findings suggest that multi-agent superiority is bounded by task structure rather than universal, and that more agents do not necessarily make a system more intelligent.
papers.summary_zh: 大语言模型和单智能体框架的快速发展重塑了自主系统的格局，由此引出一个关键问题：多智能体协作何时能带来真正价值。随着单个智能体能力持续扩展，多智能体协作面临收益递减，同时上下文开销不断增长。通过系统分析，作者刻画了多智能体协作相对于单智能体方案的能力边界，表明其在具有稀疏依赖的长时程任务中具有系统性优势，而在紧耦合的顺序工作流中单智能体框架仍更优。基于这些洞见，作者提出SAIGE，一种基于语义感知增量图演化的轻量级多智能体协作机制。SAIGE将协作建模为动态演化的图，节点是按需生成的智能体实例，边编码通过基于内容的信息检索建立的语义依赖。在长时程复杂任务基准上的实验表明，SAIGE在上下文效率与任务性能之间取得良好权衡，且扩大智能体池或加深递归层级并不总能持续改善结果。研究结果表明，多智能体的优越性受任务结构约束而非普遍成立，更多智能体并不必然使系统更智能。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提示，在城市更新等复杂时空任务中引入多智能体协作时，应优先考虑任务是否具有长时程、稀疏依赖的结构特征，而非盲目增加智能体数量；语义感知的图演化机制或可迁移用于地理空间智能中的多源信息协同。

papers.title: TrialAtlas: Multi-Agent Research Organization for Clinical Trial Design and Optimization
papers.title_zh: TrialAtlas：面向临床试验设计与优化的多智能体研究组织
papers.reason: 该论文提出记忆增强的多智能体研究组织，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向高度相关，但应用领域为临床试验设计而非城市或地理空间。
papers.abstract: Nearly 90% of drugs entering clinical development ultimately fail, despite billions of dollars in investment. Pharmaceutical companies therefore rely on clinical development planning (CDP) and probability of technical and regulatory success assessment to anticipate development risks, yet these decisions remain labor-intensive and subjective, requiring experts across clinical science, statistics, regulatory affairs, and competitive intelligence to jointly acquire, synthesize, and reason over heterogeneous evidence. Here, we introduce TrialAtlas, a memory-augmented multi-agent research organization for CDP that mirrors this collaborative process by coordinating specialized agents for literature synthesis, competitive trial intelligence, regulatory precedent analysis, and integrated reasoning over trial design and development risk. TrialAtlas further learns from historical clinical trials and regulatory outcomes, including prior New Drug Applications (NDAs), to ground its decisions in accumulated development experience. To evaluate these capabilities in an authentic regulatory setting, we introduce TrialAtlasBench, constructed from 291 FDA Complete Response Letters and spanning three practical tasks: detecting trial design deficiencies, recommending actionable design improvements, and predicting technical and regulatory success. TrialAtlas achieves an F1 score of 50.0% for deficiency detection, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.1 points, and reaches 85.3% balanced accuracy and 84.7% F1 for prediction of technical and regulatory success, improving over the best baselines by 6.7 points in balanced accuracy and 12.0 points in Cohen's kappa. In expert evaluation, 86.4% of TrialAtlas-generated concerns were judged valid, compared with 83.1% for OpenAI DeepResearch and 59.3% for Gemini DeepResearch.
papers.summary_zh: 尽管投入数十亿美元，进入临床开发的药物中近90%最终失败。因此制药公司依赖临床开发规划（CDP）和技术与监管成功概率评估来预判开发风险，但这些决策仍然劳动密集且主观，需要临床科学、统计学、监管事务和竞争情报领域的专家共同获取、综合并推理异构证据。本文提出TrialAtlas，一个面向CDP的记忆增强多智能体研究组织，通过协调文献综合、竞争性试验情报、监管先例分析和试验设计与开发风险综合推理等专门智能体，模拟这一协作过程。TrialAtlas进一步从历史临床试验和监管结果（包括既往新药申请NDA）中学习，使其决策扎根于积累的开发经验。为在真实监管环境中评估这些能力，作者构建了TrialAtlasBench，基于291份FDA完整回复函，涵盖三项实际任务：检测试验设计缺陷、推荐可操作的设计改进、预测技术与监管成功。TrialAtlas在缺陷检测上取得50.0%的F1，超过最强基线6.1个百分点；在技术与监管成功预测上达到85.3%的平衡准确率和84.7%的F1，较最佳基线在平衡准确率上提升6.7个百分点，在Cohen's kappa上提升12.0个百分点。在专家评估中，TrialAtlas生成的问题有86.4%被判定有效，而OpenAI DeepResearch为83.1%，5（原文截断）。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作的记忆增强多智能体协作与从历史案例中学习的框架，可为城市更新决策中的多源证据综合提供架构参考，但论文未涉及城市或地理空间场景。

papers.title: Proxifield: Decentralized Multi-Agent Communication through Semantic Proximity
papers.title_zh: Proxifield：通过语义邻近实现的去中心化多智能体通信
papers.reason: 该文提出基于语义邻近的去中心化多智能体通信协议，并在无人机搜救场景中验证，与LLM和多智能体方向相关，且涉及无人机应用，但核心贡献在通信协议而非地理空间分析。
papers.abstract: As LLM capabilities have expanded, multi-agent communication has emerged as an increasingly active area of research. Prevailing protocols often adopt rigid structures that introduce coordination bottlenecks and can degrade as the number of agents increases. We introduce Proxifield, a round-adaptive multi-agent protocol with decentralized agent decision-making that constructs sparse communication graphs from the evolving semantic proximity of agents. Without model training or a centralized planner, Proxifield connects agents using four routing signals derived at inference time: direct address, information needs, plan alignment, and information complementarity. We compare Proxifield with two representative coordination baselines, a centralized Star protocol and a decentralized Shared Context protocol, across two domains: Drone Search and Rescue and the collective-reasoning benchmark HiddenBench. We first ablate base-model capability and find that, in both domains, the performance of Proxifield improves with model size (35B -> 397B parameter model) and Proxifield outperforms all baselines at the largest scale. As team size increases, Proxifield's task-reward advantage over Star widens from 5.4% at (N=5) to 53.0% at (N=25) and 59.5% at (N=50), while Shared Context consistently underperforms both protocols. Proxifield is also substantially more robust to permanent agent failure, retaining 73.6% of its no-failure task reward under the most severe condition, compared with 58.3% for Shared Context and 38.8% for Star. These results demonstrate that decentralized, semantically adaptive routing can improve the scalability and fault tolerance of multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型能力的扩展，多智能体通信已成为日益活跃的研究领域。主流协议往往采用刚性结构，引入协调瓶颈，并可能随智能体数量增加而性能退化。作者提出Proxifield，一种具有去中心化智能体决策的轮次自适应多智能体协议，从智能体不断演化的语义邻近性构建稀疏通信图。无需模型训练或集中式规划器，Proxifield在推理时使用四种路由信号连接智能体：直接寻址、信息需求、计划对齐和信息互补性。作者在两个领域将Proxifield与两种代表性协调基线（集中式Star协议和去中心化Shared Context协议）进行比较：无人机搜救和集体推理基准HiddenBench。首先消融基础模型能力，发现在两个领域中Proxifield的性能随模型规模提升（35B至397B参数模型），且在最大规模下优于所有基线。随着团队规模增加，Proxifield相对Star的任务奖励优势从N=5时的5.4%扩大到N=25时的53.0%和N=50时的59.5%，而Shared Context始终表现不及两种协议。Proxifield对永久性智能体故障也具有显著更强的鲁棒性，在最严重条件下保留其无故障任务奖励的73.6%，而Shared Context为58.3%，Star为38.8%。这些结果表明，去中心化、语义自适应的路由可提升多智能体系统的可扩展性和容错性。
papers.insight_zh: 该协议的去中心化语义路由思路，可为城市更新中分布式传感器网络或多无人机协同观测的通信架构设计提供参考，其容错性优势对存在节点失效风险的地理空间感知系统具有潜在价值。

papers.title: LLM-Generated Feature Pools for Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.title_zh: 面向时间序列异常检测的LLM生成特征池
papers.reason: 该论文研究LLM生成特征池用于时间序列异常检测，与时空数据挖掘和LLM应用方向相关，但聚焦单变量时间序列而非地理空间数据。
papers.abstract: We study how far a simple statistical pipeline can go on univariate time series anomaly detection under a strict selection protocol. The method extracts a small pool of statistics over sliding windows, scores each window with a transductive robust (MAD) model, and selects a feature subset per domain on a held-out tuning split. On TSB-AD-U it reaches $0.529$ per-series VUS-PR, above the best neural ($0.45$) and statistical ($0.44$) entries on the public leaderboard and within $0.06$ of the strongest pretrained foundation model, several of which use more supervision than ours. Ablations locate the cause: across three selection strategies and a hindsight oracle the score moves by $0.031$, and across the aggregation grid by $0.096$, while changing the candidate pool moves it by $0.226$. The candidate pool sets the ceiling; the search over it is second-order. We therefore generate a pool per domain by prompting a multimodal LLM with in-context example windows from that domain. The generated pools match the hand-crafted one under matched selection, and the two cover different domains: selecting over their union improves on the generated pool in all twelve generator-seed pairs and lifts the pipeline to $0.588$, matching the performance of the best entry on the leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究在严格选择协议下，一个简单的统计流水线在单变量时间序列异常检测上能达到何种程度。该方法在滑动窗口上提取一小组统计量，用直推式稳健（MAD）模型对每个窗口打分，并在留出的调优划分上按领域选择特征子集。在TSB-AD-U上，该方法达到每序列0.529的VUS-PR，高于公开排行榜上最佳神经（0.45）和统计（0.44）条目，并接近最强预训练基础模型（差距0.06以内），而后者中有若干使用了比本文更多的监督。消融实验定位了原因：在三种选择策略和一个事后oracle下，分数变动0.031；在聚合网格上变动0.096；而更换候选池则变动0.226。候选池决定了上限，对其的搜索是二阶的。因此作者通过向多模态LLM提示该领域的上下文示例窗口，为每个领域生成一个特征池。在匹配选择下，生成池与手工池相当，且二者覆盖不同领域：在它们的并集上选择在全部十二个生成器-种子组合中均优于生成池，并将流水线提升至0.588，与排行榜最佳条目持平。
papers.insight_zh: 候选池决定性能上限这一发现，对时空特征工程中特征库构建有方法论启示，但论文未涉及地理空间数据或城市应用。

papers.title: Extending Decoupled Attention to Dense Prediction and Masked Training for Multi-Channel Images
papers.title_zh: 将解耦注意力扩展至多通道图像的密集预测与掩码训练
papers.reason: 该论文研究多通道图像的视觉Transformer架构改进，涉及卫星影像等密集预测任务，与遥感图像处理和地理空间智能有一定关联。
papers.abstract: Multi-Channel imaging (MCI) data differs fundamentally from natural images, as each channel records a semantically distinct signal rather than a colour band. To adapt vision encoders to MCI data, Multi-Channel Vision Transformers (MC-ViTs) tokenize each channel independently and concatenate the resulting tokens into one sequence, and the channel count is no longer fixed by the architecture. Self-attention is then computed across all channel-patch tokens with no restriction on which channels attend to which, which dilutes the features of individual channels. The Decoupled Vision Transformer (DC-ViT) regulates this by separating updates computed within a channel from updates computed across channels, and by forming a representation per channel before the channels are combined. Its formulation, however, pairs tokens by spatial position, and thus requires the same visible tokens in every channel. Correspondence under independent per-channel masking is recovered by solving a linear assignment between the retained patches of each channel, which allows decoupled attention to be combined with current masked multi-channel training in its standard configuration rather than a restricted one. Across three classification and three segmentation benchmarks spanning fluorescence microscopy, imaging mass cytometry and satellite imaging, including dense prediction at high channel counts, the resulting formulation outperforms the strongest MC-ViT baseline.
papers.summary_zh: 多通道成像（MCI）数据与自然图像有本质区别，每个通道记录语义上不同的信号而非颜色波段。为将视觉编码器适配MCI数据，多通道视觉Transformer（MC-ViT）独立地对每个通道进行标记化，并将生成的标记拼接为一个序列，通道数不再由架构固定。自注意力在所有通道-块标记上计算，不限制哪些通道关注哪些通道，从而稀释了单个通道的特征。解耦视觉Transformer（DC-ViT）通过分离通道内更新与跨通道更新，并在通道组合前为每个通道形成表示来规范这一过程。然而其公式按空间位置配对标记，因此要求每个通道具有相同的可见标记。本文通过求解各通道保留块之间的线性分配来恢复独立逐通道掩码下的对应关系，使解耦注意力能够以标准配置而非受限配置与当前掩码多通道训练相结合。在涵盖荧光显微镜、成像质谱流式细胞术和卫星成像的三个分类和三个分割基准上，包括高通道数的密集预测，所提公式优于最强的MC-ViT基线。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作对多通道遥感影像的Transformer建模具有方法学参考价值，尤其是通道解耦注意力机制可能有助于处理多光谱/高光谱遥感数据中的通道异质性问题。

papers.title: When Better Turns Do Not Make Better Agents: Diagnosing the Gap Between Next-Turn Metrics and Workflow Success
papers.title_zh: 当更好的轮次并不造就更好的智能体：诊断下一轮指标与工作流成功之间的差距
papers.reason: 该文研究LLM智能体在多轮工作流中的评估问题，与LLM和多智能体研究方向相关，但未涉及地理空间应用。
papers.abstract: Agent models are frequently evaluated one decision at a time, where the model predicts the next action based on the gold interaction history, which is scored against a reference. We investigate whether improvement under this protocol is predictive of improved autonomous workflow execution. We study pre-SFT and supervised fine-tuned (SFT) Qwen3 models at 4B and 14B parameters and Gemma 3 models at 4B and 12B parameters on multi-turn customer-support workflows. We find that SFT consistently improves text-turn success, and that overall next-turn success increases for every model under gold-history evaluation. However, these improvements do not transfer to autonomous workflow execution. Tool-specific gains also vary across metrics and models. None of the four SFT models succeeds under holistic workflow evaluation, with strict trajectory completion reaching at most 10.4% workflow success. Our results show that next-turn evaluation is not a reliable proxy for workflow success, motivating separate reporting of text quality, local action correctness, tool execution, and end-to-end task completion.
papers.summary_zh: 智能体模型常以单次决策方式评估，即模型基于金标准交互历史预测下一动作，并与参考进行评分。我们研究该协议下的改进是否能预测自主工作流执行的改善。我们研究预SFT和监督微调（SFT）的Qwen3模型（4B和14B参数）以及Gemma 3模型（4B和12B参数）在多轮客户支持工作流上的表现。我们发现SFT持续提升文本轮次成功率，且在金标准历史评估下所有模型的整体下一轮成功率均提高。然而，这些改进并未迁移到自主工作流执行。工具特定增益也因指标和模型而异。四个SFT模型均未在整体工作流评估中成功，严格轨迹完成的工作流成功率最高仅为10.4%。结果表明下一轮评估不是工作流成功的可靠代理，因此有必要分别报告文本质量、局部动作正确性、工具执行和端到端任务完成情况。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提示在构建基于LLM的多智能体地理空间工作流时，局部动作指标的提升未必带来端到端任务成功，需要设计面向完整工作流的评估体系。

papers.title: Signal-Centric Remote Sensing via Alternative Preprocessing and Acoustic Processing for ML-Driven Applications
papers.title_zh: 以信号为中心的遥感：面向机器学习应用的替代预处理与声学处理方法
papers.reason: 该文提出以CSV格式数据替代图像表示的遥感数据处理方法，并借鉴声学处理，涉及遥感信号处理与机器学习应用，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合有一定关联，但未涉及变化检测或地理空间语义。
papers.abstract: The dominant method of processing sonar data is using image-based representations, requiring the preprocessing of image data on autonomous systems. We propose an alternative data processing method for remote sensing applications via the use of data in Comma-Seperated Value format. Experimentation on our alternative approach shows a reduction of processing time by 91.18%, an improvement in accurate object detection by Machine Learning, and an increase in SNR (Signal-to-noise ratio), PSNR (Peak signal-to-noise ratio), and other evaluation metrics.
papers.summary_zh: 声纳数据的主流处理方式是使用图像表示，这需要在自主系统上对图像数据进行预处理。该文提出一种替代的数据处理方法，即在遥感应用中使用逗号分隔值（CSV）格式的数据。实验表明，该替代方法将处理时间减少91.18%，提升了机器学习目标检测的准确性，并提高了信噪比（SNR）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）等评价指标。
papers.insight_zh: 该文提示，在遥感与声纳等信号处理场景中，绕过图像化预处理、直接使用信号格式数据可能显著降低处理时间并改善检测与信噪比指标，为机器学习驱动的遥感应用提供了替代预处理思路。

papers.title: Image-Derived PM10 Estimation in Cattle Feedlot Using Machine Learning: Addressing Concentration Ranges Beyond Existing Digital Imaging Methods
papers.title_zh: 基于图像的养牛场PM10估算：面向超越现有数字成像方法的浓度范围
papers.reason: 该文利用图像特征与机器学习估算养牛场PM10浓度，属于环境遥感与图像监测交叉方向，与遥感变化检测、多源数据融合及地理空间智能有一定方法学关联，但应用场景为畜牧环境而非城市更新。
papers.abstract: Affordable dust monitoring remains a pressing need for the cattle feedlot industry, yet camera-based PM estimation, despite its growing body of research in urban air quality settings, has not been evaluated under the extended concentration ranges characteristic of intensive livestock operations. This study developed an image-based approach using contrast panel features and machine learning to estimate PM10 concentrations in a commercial cattle feedlot, where hourly average PM10 ranged from 250 to 1,000 ug/m^-3 and instantaneous concentrations reached 5,000 to 20,000 ug/m^-3. Grayscale images were captured during the evening dust peak period, and features including panel contrast, black and white panel pixel values, and overall image brightness were extracted. The model also incorporated recent past values from preceding images and solar zenith angle as predictors. Among the candidate models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest predictive performance, with an R^2 of 0.792 and a median absolute error of 103 ug/m^-3. Feature importance analysis revealed that (a) panels positioned farthest from the camera contributed most strongly to predictions and (b) that black panel pixel values were more sensitive than white panel values to changes in PM10 concentration. Prediction accuracy during the sunset transition, which coincides with the onset of the feedlot evening dust peak, remains an area for further refinement. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of image-based PM10 estimation across PM concentration ranges substantially exceeding those reported in prior urban studies and provide practical guidelines for future deployment in feedlot environments.
papers.summary_zh: 经济实惠的粉尘监测仍是养牛业迫切需求，然而尽管基于相机的PM估算在城市空气质量研究中日益增多，其尚未在集约化畜牧作业特有的扩展浓度范围内得到评估。本研究开发了一种基于图像的方法，利用对比面板特征和机器学习估算商业养牛场的PM10浓度，其中小时平均PM10范围为250至1000 μg/m^-3，瞬时浓度可达5000至20000 μg/m^-3。灰度图像在傍晚粉尘峰值时段采集，提取的特征包括面板对比度、黑白面板像素值以及整体图像亮度。模型还纳入前序图像的近期历史值和太阳天顶角作为预测因子。在候选模型中，XGBoost取得最高预测性能，R^2为0.792，中位绝对误差为103 μg/m^-3。特征重要性分析显示：(a) 距相机最远的面板对预测贡献最大；(b) 黑色面板像素值比白色面板值对PM10浓度变化更敏感。日落过渡时段的预测精度（恰逢养牛场傍晚粉尘峰值开始）仍有待进一步改进。这些发现证明了在远超以往城市研究报告的PM浓度范围内进行基于图像的PM10估算的可行性，并为未来在养牛场环境中的部署提供了实用指南。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作展示了图像特征与机器学习在极高浓度粉尘环境中的PM10估算可行性，其对比面板与光照因子设计或可迁移至遥感影像的大气颗粒物监测，但摘要未涉及卫星遥感或城市尺度应用。

papers.title: Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms
papers.title_zh: 跨领域整合RLVR能力：融合范式的深入研究
papers.reason: 该论文比较了三种RLVR能力融合范式，涉及多智能体训练和模型合并，与多智能体系统研究相关，可为城市更新中多领域智能体的整合提供方法论指导。
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了Merge、Mix RL和MOPD三种融合范式，发现它们平均性能差异不大，但单基准上差距可达8.6点。训练动态显示不同约束，并给出了实际选择指南：已有专家时用Merge，无专家时用Mix RL，需保留领域特定增益时用MOPD。
papers.insight_zh: 不同融合范式各有优劣，选择取决于具体场景和资源约束，这为多领域智能体能力整合提供了实用指导。

papers.title: Uni-PrevPredMap: Extending PrevPredMap to a Unified Framework of Prior-Informed Modeling for Online Vectorized HD Map Construction
papers.title_zh: Uni-PrevPredMap：将PrevPredMap扩展为在线矢量化高精地图构建的先验信息统一建模框架
papers.reason: 该论文提出统一框架Uni-PrevPredMap，用于在线矢量化高精地图构建，涉及先验信息建模与多源数据融合，与GIS中的地图构建、时空数据挖掘及地理空间智能有较强关联，尤其对自动驾驶场景下的动态地图更新有参考价值。
papers.summary_zh: 摘要内容缺失（仅提供分隔线），无法获取具体研究内容。根据标题可推断，该研究将PrevPredMap扩展为一个统一的先验信息建模框架，用于在线矢量化高精地图构建。
papers.insight_zh: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节；但从标题看，该工作涉及先验知识与在线地图构建的结合，对城市更新中的动态地图维护和时空数据融合有潜在启发，但需进一步验证其与GIS方法的兼容性。

papers.title: Multiclass Semantic Segmentation of Wildland Fire Images Using Context-Aware Centralized Copy-Paste Data Augmentation
papers.title_zh: 基于上下文感知集中复制粘贴数据增强的野火图像多类语义分割
papers.reason: 该论文研究野火图像的语义分割与上下文感知数据增强，属于遥感应用范畴，与遥感变化检测和环境监测相关。
papers.abstract: Producing accurate annotations for deep learning based image segmentation is both costly and labor intensive. This challenge is especially evident in wildland fire applications, where accurately labeled datasets are scarce due to the difficulty of collecting and annotating dynamic fire scenes. To address this problem, our previous work introduced the Centralized Copy-Paste Data Augmentation (CCPDA) method for semantic segmentation of wildland fire imagery, which generates artificial training samples by randomly pasting fire clusters from source images onto target images. However, random placement can produce contextually unrealistic scenes, such as fire burning on asphalt. In this paper, we present a context-aware strategy designed specifically to improve data quality and realism in small multiclass wildland fire datasets, ensuring that augmented samples remain contextually meaningful. The proposed method restricts fire placement to semantically valid target regions and selects the location whose Ash-Vegetation composition most closely matches the source context. This approach preserves existing fire regions in the target image, prevents unrealistic placements, and maintains contextual accuracy by generating images that resemble real wildland fire scenes. We evaluate the Context-Aware CCPDA strategy through numerical analysis and comparisons with other augmentation methods by a weighted sum-based multi-objective optimization (MOO) approach. The results confirm that the context-aware data augmentation strategy leads to improved segmentation performance and contextual realism, outperforming other augmentation procedures.
papers.summary_zh: 为基于深度学习的图像分割生成准确标注既昂贵又费力。这在野火应用中尤为明显，由于难以采集和标注动态火灾场景，准确标注的数据集十分稀缺。为解决这一问题，作者此前的工作提出了集中复制粘贴数据增强（CCPDA）方法用于野火图像语义分割，通过将源图像中的火灾簇随机粘贴到目标图像上生成人工训练样本。然而随机放置可能产生上下文不真实的场景，如沥青路面上的火灾。本文提出一种上下文感知策略，专门用于提高小型多类野火数据集的数据质量和真实性，确保增强样本保持上下文意义。所提方法将火灾放置限制在语义有效的目标区域，并选择灰烬-植被组成与源上下文最匹配的位置。该方法保留目标图像中已有的火灾区域，防止不真实放置，并通过生成类似真实野火场景的图像来保持上下文准确性。通过数值分析和与其他增强方法的比较，采用基于加权和的多目标优化（MOO）方法评估上下文感知CCPDA策略。结果证实上下文感知数据增强策略改善了分割性能和上下文真实性，优于其他增强方法。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究的上下文感知数据增强思路或可迁移至遥感变化检测中标注稀缺场景，尤其是需要保持地物语义合理性的增强样本生成。

papers.title: M2G-LLM: Enhancing Clinical Prediction via Multimodal Graph Reasoning and LLM Context Injection
papers.title_zh: M2G-LLM：通过多模态图推理与LLM上下文注入增强临床预测
papers.reason: 该文提出多模态图推理与LLM上下文注入框架，涉及多源数据融合与LLM结合，与研究中多源数据融合方向有方法关联，但应用领域为临床医学。
papers.abstract: Integrating diverse data modalities --- such as clinical notes, laboratory results, and medical imaging --- is essential for advancing clinical decision-making. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance in processing unstructured clinical text, their limited capacity to incorporate non-text modalities hinders their broader utility in healthcare applications. Here, we introduce M2G-LLM (Multimodal MedGraph-LLM), a novel framework that enhances LLMs with multimodal integration and alignment via Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Our approach models temporal relationships between patient visits, propagates information across clinically similar patients, and aligns heterogeneous data sources to construct enriched multimodal context vectors. These vectors are injected into the intermediate layers of the LLM, enabling joint reasoning over textual and non-textual modalities. We evaluate M2G-LLM on the MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-CXR datasets, demonstrating improvements in clinical prediction tasks over strong baseline models. Our results highlight the promise of combining the language understanding of LLMs with the relational reasoning capabilities of GNNs for comprehensive, multimodal healthcare analysis.
papers.summary_zh: 整合临床笔记、实验室结果和医学影像等多种数据模态对于推进临床决策至关重要。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在处理非结构化临床文本方面表现出色，但其纳入非文本模态的能力有限，阻碍了其在医疗应用中的更广泛效用。在此，我们提出M2G-LLM（多模态医学图-LLM），一个通过图神经网络（GNN）增强LLM多模态整合与对齐的新颖框架。我们的方法建模患者就诊之间的时间关系，在临床相似患者之间传播信息，并对齐异构数据源以构建丰富的多模态上下文向量。这些向量被注入LLM的中间层，实现对文本和非文本模态的联合推理。我们在MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-CXR数据集上评估M2G-LLM，证明其在临床预测任务上优于强基线模型。结果凸显了将LLM的语言理解能力与GNN的关系推理能力相结合用于全面多模态医疗分析的潜力。
papers.insight_zh: GNN与LLM中间层注入相结合的多模态融合范式，可启发地理空间智能中遥感影像、文本报告与图结构数据的联合推理，但需适配地理时空关系。

papers.title: TabScope: Question-Adaptive Scope Selection for Table Question Answering
papers.title_zh: TabScope：表格问答中的问题自适应范围选择
papers.reason: 研究长表格问答中的自适应范围选择，涉及LLM推理策略，与处理大规模地理数据表格有一定关联。
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on table question answering, yet their accuracy often degrades as table size increases. We find that this degradation is not uniform across question types. Localization-sensitive questions are particularly affected by irrelevant table content, while questions requiring broader evidence may still benefit from full-table reasoning. Based on this observation, we propose a question-adaptive framework that dynamically selects between localized and full-table reasoning. The framework constructs question-specific sub-tables through operation-aware table decomposition and uses the predicted question type to determine the appropriate reasoning mode. We further introduce silver reference sub-tables for evaluating evidence selection and construct SLQA, a benchmark based on real-world long tables. Experiments on WikiTQ and SLQA show that localization is particularly effective for lookup and local reasoning questions, while adaptive selection between localized and full-table reasoning achieves the best overall performance. These results highlight that long-table QA requires deciding not only how to localize, but also when to localize. Our code and datasets will be made available upon publication of the paper.
papers.summary_zh: 提出问题自适应框架，根据问题类型动态选择局部或全表推理，在长表格问答中取得最佳性能，并构建了SLQA基准。
papers.insight_zh: 长表格问答的关键不仅在于如何定位，还在于何时定位，问题类型决定了推理模式的选择。

papers.title: Info3R: Information-Adaptive Test-Time Training for 3D Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: Info3R：面向三维重建的信息自适应测试时训练
papers.reason: 该论文研究在线三维重建与测试时训练，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合的关联较弱，仅在三维几何感知层面有间接联系。
papers.abstract: Transformer-based models have recently achieved strong performance on 3D reconstruction from images, and recent works extend them to process video streams in an online manner for real-world deployment. However, existing methods overlook two key signals when handling long image streams: the importance of each incoming frame and the information saturation of the model's internal state. In this paper, we propose Info3R, a novel information-adaptive test-time training method for the online 3D reconstruction. We introduce an information-aware state update that modulates the state update strength based on the redundancy and informativeness of each incoming frame. To restore the state's plasticity -- its capacity to incorporate new observations -- we propose a dynamic state reset, triggered by the cumulative magnitude of state updates and the model's prediction confidence and accompanied by an anchor-to-world alignment. Our method achieves consistent improvements on camera pose estimation, video depth estimation, and 3D reconstruction, while substantially mitigating the performance degradation in the long sequence evaluation. Notably, on KITTI Odometry, our method achieves on average 1.68x lower ATE than LongStream, demonstrating its robustness on extended outdoor sequences.
papers.summary_zh: 基于Transformer的模型近期在图像三维重建上取得强劲性能，已有工作将其扩展为在线方式处理视频流以用于真实部署。然而，现有方法在处理长图像流时忽略了两个关键信号：每个输入帧的重要性以及模型内部状态的信息饱和度。本文提出Info3R，一种面向在线三维重建的信息自适应测试时训练方法。作者引入信息感知的状态更新，根据每个输入帧的冗余度和信息量调节状态更新强度。为恢复状态的塑性（即纳入新观测的能力），作者提出动态状态重置，由状态更新的累积幅度和模型预测置信度触发，并伴随锚点到世界坐标的对齐。该方法在相机位姿估计、视频深度估计和三维重建上取得一致改进，同时显著缓解长序列评估中的性能退化。值得注意的是，在KITTI Odometry上，该方法平均ATE比LongStream低1.68倍，显示其在长距离户外序列上的鲁棒性。
papers.insight_zh: 信息自适应状态更新与动态重置机制或可为长时序遥感影像的在线处理提供借鉴，但论文未涉及遥感或地理空间数据。

papers.title: OpenMAS-GCom. A Diagnostic Benchmark for Graph-enhanced Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: OpenMAS-GCom：图增强多智能体系统的诊断基准
papers.reason: 该论文研究图增强多智能体系统的诊断基准，涉及LLM智能体协作，与LLM和多智能体研究方向相关，但应用领域非GIS。
papers.abstract: Graph-enhanced multi-agent systems (G-MAS) coordinate large language model agents through communication graphs and role assignments, which determine how agents exchange information and divide responsibilities. However, final-score comparisons across systems combine differences in models, communication patterns, roles, and computation costs, making performance differences difficult to attribute to specific communication structures, role assignments, and information flows. To address this evaluation attribution problem, we introduce OpenMAS-GCom, a benchmark for diagnosing how these components affect G-MAS performance through controlled interventions. We represent systems through collaboration units, communication links, shared intermediate information, and execution rules. OpenMAS-GCom compares original systems with versions modified by changing one component while keeping tasks, models, prompts, and budget limits fixed. We rewire communication edges, remove specialist or critic agents, replace intermediate messages with incorrect content, and disable workers during execution. The benchmark evaluates 17 single-agent, ordinary multi-agent, and graph-enhanced configurations on 29 datasets across six domains. We add 400 G-MAS-Complex tasks requiring agents to combine information from multiple documents, resolve conflicting records, and return specified values with source identifiers. Experiments show larger mean losses after specialist removal than after critic removal, different performance degradation under incorrect messages and worker failures despite similar original scores, and different configurations achieving the highest accuracy and accuracy per token on G-MAS-Complex.
papers.summary_zh: 图增强多智能体系统（G-MAS）通过通信图和角色分配协调大语言模型智能体，这决定了智能体如何交换信息和划分职责。然而跨系统的最终分数比较混合了模型、通信模式、角色和计算成本的差异，使得性能差异难以归因于特定的通信结构、角色分配和信息流。为解决这一评估归因问题，本文提出OpenMAS-GCom，一个通过受控干预诊断这些组件如何影响G-MAS性能的基准。系统通过协作单元、通信链路、共享中间信息和执行规则来表示。OpenMAS-GCom将原始系统与仅改变一个组件而保持任务、模型、提示和预算限制不变的修改版本进行比较。实验重新连接通信边、移除专家或批评者智能体、用错误内容替换中间消息、在执行期间禁用工作者。该基准在六个领域的29个数据集上评估17种单智能体、普通多智能体和图增强配置。新增400个G-MAS-Complex任务，要求智能体组合多文档信息、解决冲突记录并返回带来源标识符的指定值。实验表明专家移除后的平均损失大于批评者移除，错误消息和工作器故障下性能退化不同，不同配置在G-MAS-Complex上达到最高准确率和每token准确率。
papers.insight_zh: 该基准的诊断方法论或可启发GIS领域中基于LLM的多智能体空间分析系统的评估设计，但其应用场景与城市更新和遥感无直接关联。

papers.title: Refine Then Fusion: Training-Free 3D Point Cloud Adaptation with Priority Refinement and Multi-Modal Knowledge Fusion
papers.title_zh: 先精炼再融合：基于优先精炼与多模态知识融合的免训练3D点云适配
papers.reason: 该论文提出免训练3D点云少样本识别框架，涉及多模态知识融合与可靠性感知聚合，与多源数据融合方向有方法论关联，但应用为3D视觉而非地理空间遥感。
papers.abstract: Recent pre-trained foundation models provide rich multi-modal priors for downstream 3D vision tasks. However, the effectiveness of these representations in few-shot scenarios is limited by two fundamental challenges: High-dimensional features often contain substantial channel redundancy and task-irrelevant noise, while the reliability of different modalities varies across samples. Consequently, direct aggregation of heterogeneous representations overlooks sample-dependent modality reliability and may obscure the discriminative cues essential. To address these limitations, we propose Refine Then Fusion(RTF), a training-free framework for few-shot 3D recognition. RTF first identifies discriminative feature channels by jointly modeling inter-class similarity and intra-class stability, thereby decoupling domain-specific knowledge refinement from the cached representations of pre-trained models. It then introduces a reliability-aware fusion mechanism that estimates sample-wise modality reliability from the distribution shifts induced by feature refinement, enabling adaptive aggregation of multi-modal representations. Furthermore, RTF constructs a memory cache that integrates instance-level support features with class-level prototypes to infer query labels. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that RTF consistently outperforms single-modal baselines, partial-fusion variants, and existing lightweight adaptation methods, achieving state-of-the-art few-shot 3D recognition performance without gradient optimization, additional training data, auxiliary training, or parameter updates.
papers.summary_zh: 近期预训练基础模型为下游3D视觉任务提供丰富的多模态先验。然而这些表征在少样本场景中的有效性受两个基本挑战限制：高维特征常含大量通道冗余与任务无关噪声，而不同模态的可靠性因样本而异。因此直接聚合异构表征忽视了样本依赖的模态可靠性，可能掩盖关键的判别线索。为解决这些局限，作者提出先精炼再融合（RTF），一种用于少样本3D识别的免训练框架。RTF首先通过联合建模类间相似度与类内稳定性识别判别性特征通道，从而将领域特定知识精炼与预训练模型的缓存表征解耦。随后引入可靠性感知融合机制，从特征精炼引起的分布偏移估计样本级模态可靠性，实现多模态表征的自适应聚合。此外，RTF构建记忆缓存，整合实例级支持特征与类级原型以推断查询标签。在五个基准上的大量实验表明，RTF持续优于单模态基线、部分融合变体及现有轻量适配方法，在无需梯度优化、额外训练数据、辅助训练或参数更新的情况下实现最先进的少样本3D识别性能。
papers.insight_zh: 其可靠性感知的多模态融合与免训练适配策略可启发遥感多源数据融合中的模态可靠性建模，但需验证其在遥感影像与点云融合场景中的适用性。
